_about: What @ai-sdk/anthropic does with temperature, top_p and top_k before a request leaves the app, by release. Read from the package's published dist (npm, Apache-2.0, Copyright 2023 Vercel, Inc.) at each release in `seen`, by bisecting between releases whose outcome differs; 23 Nov 2026. A version between two read releases with the same outcome is taken to have it too. Rules are the release's own model-id tests in first-match order (`includes`: a substring, `regex`: a pattern); `rejects` means the release drops the three settings with an 'unsupported' warning for that model. `unknownClaudeRejects`: a claude- id no rule matches is treated as rejecting them too. `dropsRejected` false: everything is sent.
